description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'ZendeskHelpProcessorTest' for testing the functionality of the 'ZendeskHelpProcessor' class. It includes setup methods, and various test methods for testing URL generation, HTTP client retrieval, and response handling related to Zendesk help center integrations within the OrangeHRM plugin architecture.

classes.name: ZendeskHelpProcessorTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the functionalities of the ZendeskHelpProcessor, including URL generation, HTTP client interactions, and error handling scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of ZendeskHelpProcessor, and populates test data from a YAML fixture.

methods.name: testGetHelpConfigService
methods.description: Verifies the 'getHelpConfigService' method returns an instance of HelpConfigService.

methods.name: testGetHttpClient
methods.description: Verifies the 'getHttpClient' method returns a GuzzleHttp Client instance.

methods.name: testGetBaseUrl
methods.description: Checks that 'getBaseUrl' returns the expected service URL.

methods.name: testGetSearchUrl
methods.description: Tests that 'getSearchUrl' constructs the correct search URL with given label parameters.

methods.name: testGetRedirectUrl
methods.description: Mocks an HTTP response for a successful article lookup and verifies 'getRedirectUrl' returns the article URL.

methods.name: testGetRedirectUrl2
methods.description: Mocks a response with no results and verifies that 'getRedirectUrl' defaults to the main help URL.

methods.name: testGetRedirectUrl3
methods.description: Mocks an exception during HTTP request and checks that 'getRedirectUrl' gracefully falls back to the default URL.

methods.name: testGetDefaultRedirectUrl
methods.description: Verifies the default redirect URL returned by 'getDefaultRedirectUrl'.
